title: [Bug]: @x402/fetch client signs and submits a payment for ANY amount the server declares in the 402 requirements — x10 overcharge captured, spend limit is the only guard
quote: in the default configuration the client treats the amount of the 402 accepts[] entry as the price to pay. There is no built-in notion of a "price expectation" the client could cross-check against, so any malicious, compromised, or MITM'd server ... can charge an automated agent arbitrarily up to its per-payment cap.

title: `@x402/core` pins `zod ^3.24.2`, so GHSA-mrhx-c7xc-m3w5 (high) has no fix path downstream
quote: GHSA-mrhx-c7xc-m3w5 (CVE-2023-54404, high, CVSS 7.5: memory exhaustion when validating a large array with no length limit) is fixed only in zod 4.6.6, and there's no patched 3.x. So every project that depends on @x402/core and runs npm audit --audit-level=high in CI has to either fail the build or allowlist the advisory indefinitely.
